id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

start.description: Start timestamp for the value.  If null, assumed to be beginning-of-time (BOT).

end.description: End timestamp for the value.  If null, assumed to be end-of-time (EOT).

from.description: The instance of {@link MlSubject} referenced by the relation.

to.description: The {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel} referenced by the relation

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

route.description: The {@link MlModel.Route} that originated this relation.

status.description:
The deployment status of the relation, in particular if it is {@link MlModel.Route.Status.Label.CHAMPION CHAMPION},
{@link MlModel.Route.Status.Label.CHALLENGER CHALLENGER} or {@link MlModel.Route.Status.Label.RETIRED RETIRED}.

groupId.description:
The group ID of the relation, which is used to group together relations that were created as part of the same
batch. This can help optimize the fetch of these relations when doing batch operations.
For example, see {@link MlModel.Router#updateRouteBatch}.

reliabilityRiskMLProjectId.description: The id of the current reliability risk {@link MlProject}. Fetched from {@link ReliabilityMLConfig}.

predictionHistory.description: This field stores the historical information of the predicion status and reasons of failure for this relation.

isPredictionHistory.description:
Denotes if the relation has any prediction histories populated.
The stored calc was added since predictionHistory is in kv store
and kv store does not support `exists(predictionHistory)`.

latestPrediction.description: The latest record of {@link RiskMlModelPredictionHistory} for which the model is predicting.

earliestPrediction.description: The earliest record of {@link RiskMlModelPredictionHistory} for which the model is non-predicting.

nonPredicitngDuration.description: The duration (in days) for which this relation has been non-predicting.

title:
An extension of {@link ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation} representing timed relations between
a {@link ReliabilityAsset} and a model belonging to the `reliabilityRisk` {@link MlProject}.
name: ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation
